services_intro.heading: Electrical and remodeling for homes like yours
services_intro.text: A full panel, a circuit that keeps tripping, a kitchen that no longer works, a bathroom that has to be rebuilt. MB Construction and Electric takes the electrical work and the remodeling. Homeowners have called this company since 1978. The license is CSLB #352894, and the company is licensed and insured.

why.heading: Why choose MB Construction and Electric

items.title: Licensed and insured
items.text: The published California contractor license is CSLB #352894. Electrical work and remodeling are done by a company that is licensed and insured.

items.title: Working since 1978
items.text: Homeowners in La Quinta have called MB Construction and Electric for electrical work and remodeling since 1978.

items.title: Electrical and the build
items.text: A circuit that trips, a panel with no open spaces, a kitchen that does not fit how you cook, a bath that needs new work. Those jobs stay with one company instead of two separate crews.

items.title: The work we list
items.text: Wiring, panels, lighting, ceiling fans, generators, EV chargers, kitchens, bathrooms, room and garage additions, ADUs, and design-build projects are on the published service list.

items.title: Hours you can plan around
items.text: The office is open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Saturday and Sunday are closed, so a visit is set on a weekday.

items.title: A clear way to start
items.text: Call (760) 227-5499 or send the quote form. Share the address and whether the job is electrical, a remodel, or both.

process.heading: From the first call to the finished work

steps.title: Call or send a note
steps.text: Phone (760) 227-5499 or use the quote form. Leave your name and the best way to reach you.

steps.title: Describe the project
steps.text: Say whether you need electrical work, a remodel, or both, and which city the property is in.

steps.title: Pick a weekday time
steps.text: Visits are scheduled Monday through Friday between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.

steps.title: Complete the agreed work
steps.text: We do the electrical or construction work we discussed, with safety in mind on every job.

safety.heading: Safety on electrical work
safety.text: Safety is not a matter we take lightly. Electrical repairs, panels, circuits, and lighting are handled by a licensed contractor, CSLB #352894.

items.q: Do you do both electrical work and remodeling?
items.a: Yes. MB Construction and Electric is an electrician and a general contractor. Electrical services and construction services are both published on this site, so a panel and a kitchen can be talked through with the same company.

items.q: What electrical problems can you take on?
items.a: Residential work includes panel changes, service upgrades, energy-efficient lighting, ceiling fans, breaker and fuse replacement, electric water heaters, and circuit repair. Installation work also includes new circuits, exhaust fans, EV chargers, home and commercial generators, and carbon monoxide and smoke detectors.

items.q: Can you remodel a kitchen or a bathroom?
items.a: Yes. Kitchen remodeling and bathroom remodeling are published services, including planning from the first idea through the finished room. Whole-house updates are listed under home renovations.

items.q: What should I tell you when I call?
items.a: Your name, a phone number, the property address, and whether you need electrical work, a remodel, or both. If a light, a panel, or a room is the issue, say which one.

items.q: How do I ask for a quote?
items.a: Call (760) 227-5499 or send the form on this site. Thank you for contacting us. We will get back to you as soon as possible.
Cash, money transfers, Zelle, and check.
